Container.Name: TidyShop-Connector
Container.Overview:
Self-hosted family sharing server for the TidyShop shopping-list app for Android. Shared lists, live updates, household members with per-list permissions, and member backups, all stored on your own server in a single JSON file. Single sign-on (Authentik or any OIDC provider) is optional: phones can enrol with a hardware-backed device key and a single-use invite code instead.
IMPORTANT: the TidyShop app only talks to HTTPS servers, so put this container behind a reverse proxy (Nginx Proxy Manager, SWAG, Nginx, Caddy...) with a valid certificate. Setup guide: https://jimz011.github.io/tidyshop-connector/
Container.Requires: A reverse proxy with a valid HTTPS certificate and a hostname your phones can reach.

Config.Name: Pairing key
Config.Description: Master pairing key, at least 12 characters (generate one with: openssl rand -hex 24). It admits the family owner and recovers lost phones, so treat it like an administrator password. Leave empty to read it from the pairing key file instead.

Config.Name: WebUI / API port
Config.Description: Port the connector listens on. Point your reverse proxy here. Do not forward it to the internet directly.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Connector state (state.json), and optionally pairing-key.txt and icon.png.

Config.Name: OIDC issuer (optional)
Config.Description: Optional single sign-on. The issuer URL of your OIDC provider, e.g. https://auth.example.com/application/o/tidyshop/ for Authentik. Leave empty to use device keys and invite codes only.

Config.Name: OIDC audience
Config.Description: The OIDC client id the access tokens are issued for. Only used when an issuer is set.

Config.Name: Pairing key file
Config.Description: Used only when the Pairing key variable is empty. Path inside the container of a file holding the key.

Config.Name: Data file
Config.Description: Where the connector keeps its state.
